description: Required separately supplied robot and perception assets, at paths relative to the asset root. The Cocina Asier room is fetched and verified separately by scripts/kitchen_assets.py before offline bundle assembly. The assembly itself performs no downloads.

licenses.source: Preserve the CASCADE MIT license and authorship.
licenses.procedural_props: Original orange, platter and task props: retain demo/scene/NOTICE.md and the scoped CC0-1.0 dedication in demo/scene/props/LICENSE.txt.
licenses.robot: Retain assets/REBOT_UPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt and assets/REBOT_PROVENANCE.md, including the legacy metadata distinction.
licenses.perception: Supply the pinned weights under their upstream terms; these files are not redistributed in this checkout.
licenses.kitchen: Cocina Asier owner-authorized room geometry, original replacement surfaces and verified ambientCG CC0 wood maps; retain the release NOTICE.md and sources.json.
